pages.text: Rain poured all night. The swollen river kept them inside today. Raju, Mina, and little Sonu sat side by side in the room.
Mom brought steaming bread. Mina touched a piece and quickly pulled away. Bread tasted best while this hot.
Mina tried each of the three pieces on their palm. Raju's looked a little bigger. "These aren't equal."
Mina tore a little off Raju's and moved it. Now Sonu's looked bigger.
Mina tore Sonu's, too. Crumbs piled on the plate.
Raju pressed their bread with a finger. "It's all cold."
No steam rose anymore. The outside was hard. All three chewed the hard bread.
Clearing the plate, Mom said, "The bread cooled while you matched the sizes." Mina looked at the remaining pieces.
The next morning, bread came again. The river was still high. Mina simply gave one to each.
All three bit at once. Blow, blow—hot! The inside was fluffy and sweet.
